source.hash_basis: sha256 of the LF-normalized UTF-8 text of the input actually used for this derivation, not of a separately read file and not of canonical JSON
source.note: Derived view only. The frozen summary is never modified.

reproduction_rate.unavailable_reason: No attempt records a reproduction outcome. Execution completing is not symptom reproduction, and the incident-specific reproduction assessment added after this campaign is not applied retroactively.

time_to_reproduction_seconds.unavailable_reason: No reproduction timestamp or duration was retained per attempt.

time_to_final_verdict_seconds.denominator: attempts reaching an independent final verdict (independently_verified true): 4 of 12
time_to_final_verdict_seconds.note: Time to a final verdict, accepting or rejecting. A rejected repair is a verdict, not a resolution, so this is not a resolution time. The 8 unresolved attempts are excluded and reported as runtime below.

successful_resolution_time_seconds.unavailable_reason: elapsed_seconds measures wall-clock time to a verdict, not a resolution-specific interval, and no separate resolution timestamp was retained. The 2 accepted attempts are reported under time_to_final_verdict_seconds instead.

clean_workload_failures.denominator: 8 clean case instances across 4 independently evaluated attempts
clean_workload_failures.note: Counts clean case instances with a failed property or a non-accepting case decision. Named failures, not regressions: the campaign retained no baseline run of these cases, so no baseline-to-candidate comparison is possible. Attempts that never reached evaluation contribute none.

lost_orders.unavailable_reason: No order-level count was retained. P3 is a property verdict, not a count of lost orders. Attempts with a P3 failure: [10, 11].

duplicate_effects.unavailable_reason: No duplicate-effect count was retained. P1 and P6 are property verdicts, not counts, and P1 did not fail in any evaluated attempt.

limitations: Derived from retained fields only; no re-execution and no new measurement.
Property statuses are pass, fail or not_applicable. not_applicable is not a failure.
Metrics over evaluated attempts describe 4 of 12; the 8 unresolved attempts are preserved and counted in every denominator that mentions them.
No variant ranking is supported or implied, per the frozen campaign.
